logger.message: #[%dw 2.0 output application/java --- "Before to split the payload, with following body: " ++ write(payload, "application/json")]

ee:transform.doc:name: Split the payload and store the ackId

ee:variables.ee:set-variable: %dw 2.0 output application/json --- payload filterObject ((value, key) -> !(key as String contains "orders")) update { case .gender -> if($ == "Male") "M" else if($ == "Female") "F" else "O" }

%dw 2.0 output application/json --- payload.orders map ((item, index) -> { "orderCode": item.orderCode, "quantity": item.quantity, "discount": item.discount, "description": item.order.description, "brand": item.order.brand, "price": item.order.price })
